selection_rule: positive paired rollout mean; nonnegative worst paired scenario
new_family_validation: five new families, standard response stratum; development 301-303 currently running; independently report new-family 401-405 if eligible
confirmation_rule: complete paired matrix; every family mean nonnegative; family bootstrap lower bound positive; zero action failures; budget and steps valid
failure_rule: do not promote; do not tune on confirmation and re-label it independent
